settings.editor: Preparation of the T2 corporate return for one tax year, including the GIFI schedules the return requires.
Review by a CPA Ontario registered firm before the return is transmitted.
Form T183CORP prepared for your signature, carrying your return's figures, the date and an HH:MM:SS timestamp. It is never backdated.
We are a registered EFILE electronic filer. Your return is transmitted to the Canada Revenue Agency electronically.
Emailed within 3 business days. Business days are Monday to Friday and exclude Ontario statutory holidays.
We keep your signed Form T183CORP for six years. It is not sent to the Canada Revenue Agency unless the Canada Revenue Agency asks for it.
Each tax year is a separate return at the same fee. Six unfiled years are six returns at $300.00 plus HST each.
The full amount, $339.00 per tax year including HST, is shown before you pay. Nothing is charged until you confirm.

settings.editor: Pay by credit card, debit, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Payments are processed by Stripe. We never see or store your card number.
You sign Form T183CORP as the authorized signing officer before your return is transmitted. Your signing link is single-use and expires in 72 hours.
We verify your identity and your authority to sign before we transmit. We deal with you directly and never through a third party.

settings.title: What the fee does not include

settings.text: Start now and enter your corporation name

settings.editor:
A nil T2 does not cover your Ontario annual return through the Ontario Business Registry, a federal Corporations Canada annual return at $12.00 due within 60 days of your anniversary, an Alberta AT1, a Quebec CO-17, or a nil GST/HST or payroll filing. We tell you which of these you still owe.

The $12.00 Corporations Canada fee is a government fee and HST does not apply to it.

settings.title: If your corporation is not nil

settings.editor:
This service is for a corporation with no activity in the tax year. A corporation with investment income, rental income, or dividends paid or received is not nil.

If your corporation is not nil, we move your file to gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 including HST per tax year and tell you before any further charge. No charge is taken at the higher price without you saying yes.
